language_rules.C: C89/C99 (WG14 N1256 6.9.1p12): falling off the end of a non-void function is undefined only if the caller uses the value. With the evidenced call chain (int callback discarded in a void wrapper) the missing-return form has no return-value UB, but it supplies no defined success value.
language_rules.C++: C++98 6.6.3p2: flowing off the end of a value-returning function is undefined behaviour whether or not the value is used. The missing-return form is therefore never valid C++. This file is compiled as C.

compiler_dependence: The 0-difference result relies on VC5 /O2 leaving the virtual_file_open result in EAX across an empty callee; any compiler or diagnostic implementation that clobbers EAX changes the physical result. Native builds must not depend on it.
